_comment_purpose: Sample insurance policy chunks fixture for testing the policy-citation retrieval endpoint. Each chunk represents a text block extracted from a PDF with its bounding-box coordinates.
_comment_structure: Array of chunk objects. Each: chunk_id, page (1-indexed), bbox {x, y, w, h} in 72-DPI PDF points, text, section_title, source_doc_id.
_comment_bbox_units: Bounding boxes use the PDF coordinate system at 72 DPI. An 8.5×11 inch page = 612×792 points. Origin (0,0) is bottom-left. x/y = top-left corner of the text block, w/h = width/height.
_comment_sections: Chunks cover four key policy sections: Deductible Terms, Copay Schedule, Excluded Services, Coverage Limits — these are the sections most frequently cited during bill audits.
_comment_integration: Load in tests via: json.load(open('tests/fixtures/policies/sample_policy_chunks.json'))['chunks']. Insert into 'policy_chunks' collection. The text index on the collection enables $text queries against chunk text.

chunks._comment: Deductible Terms — individual deductible amount and calendar-year reset rule

bbox._comment: Top of page 3, full-width paragraph (72 DPI: 1 inch margins → x=72, w=468)

chunks.text: Section 4.1 — Individual Deductible. The annual deductible for in-network services is $1,500 per covered individual. The deductible resets on January 1 of each calendar year. Amounts paid toward the deductible for out-of-network services do not apply to the in-network deductible.

chunks._comment: Deductible Terms — family deductible and embedded individual cap
chunks.text: Section 4.2 — Family Deductible. The family deductible is $3,000. Once any single family member meets $1,500 in covered expenses, that individual's deductible is satisfied regardless of the family total.

chunks._comment: Copay Schedule — office visit copays by tier
chunks.text: Section 6.1 — Office Visit Copayments. Primary care office visits: $25 copay. Specialist office visits: $50 copay. Urgent care facility visits: $75 copay. Copayments are due at the time of service and do not apply toward the annual deductible.

chunks._comment: Copay Schedule — emergency room copay and waiver rule
chunks.text: Section 6.2 — Emergency Room Copayment. Emergency room visits: $250 copay. The copayment is waived if the visit results in an inpatient admission within 24 hours of the ER visit.

chunks._comment: Excluded Services — cosmetic and experimental procedures
chunks.text: Section 10.1 — Excluded Services. The following services are not covered under this plan: (a) cosmetic surgery unless medically necessary for reconstruction after injury; (b) experimental or investigational treatments not approved by the FDA; (c) services rendered outside the United States except for emergency stabilization.

chunks._comment: Excluded Services — dental and vision carve-outs
chunks.text: Section 10.2 — Dental and Vision Exclusions. Routine dental care, orthodontia, and routine vision exams (including corrective lenses) are excluded. These services may be available under separate supplemental plans.

Section 7.1 — Out-of-Pocket Maximum. The annual out-of-pocket maximum for in-network services is $6,500 per individual and $13,000 per family. Once the out-of-pocket maximum is reached, the plan pays 100% of covered in-network services for the remainder of the calendar year.

Section 7.2 — Coinsurance. After the deductible is met, the plan pays 80% of allowed charges for in-network services and the member pays 20% coinsurance until the out-of-pocket maximum is reached. For out-of-network services, the plan pays 60% and the member pays 40%.

_comment_test_assertions: There should be exactly 8 chunks across 4 section titles
All bbox coordinates should be within a standard US letter page: x in [0,612], y in [0,792]
x + w should not exceed 612 (page width); y values should be positive
Each chunk_id should be unique and follow the pattern: {source_doc_id}_p{page}_{seq}
source_doc_id should be the same for all chunks in this fixture
Text search for 'deductible' should match chunks on pages 3 and 8
Text search for 'cosmetic' should match chunk on page 12
